content: Hi, could I get write access to non-master branches of mathlib please? I'd like to add the quotient topology on Projectivization, which currently has none. GitHub username zblore.
These days you should use the standard GitHub workflow (fork the repository and open a PR from your fork). In the past this was not the case; you might be following an outdated guide.
Where did you find the old information @Zayn ? It should be removed
Tbh I just saw previous people ask and thought it was the right thing to do. This is my first PR so wasn't sure, and just went with the flow.
